 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R
This is an application for taking on record the settlement agreement between the parties, dated 7.7.2023, as agreed before the Delhi Mediation Centre, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi.
Reason: Learned Sualeha vs M. Sathick @ Sadik on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/136277634/

entities.text: Learned Sualeha vs M. Sathick @ Sadik
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 counsel for the parties jointly state that payment in terms of the settlement agreement has been made by the respondent - M. Sathick @ Sadik to the petitioner  Sualeha and no further amount is due and payable.
It is also stated that the parties have mutually separated and divorce has been granted in terms of the settlement agreement.
Further, Sualeha has withdrawn the complaint case under Section 12 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, which was pending in Tiz Hazari Courts, Delhi.

entities.text: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The last prayer made is for quashing of First Information Report (FIR)
No. 212/2018 under Sections 498A, 406 and 506 read with Section 34 of the of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 registered at Police Station Lahori Gate, Delhi.
The settlement agreement states that within 30 days of divorce, Sualeha, the informant, shall file an affidavit/No Objection Certificate (NOC) for quashing of the said FIR.
Let Sualeha file her affidavit/NOC in this Court within 2 weeks from today, whereupon appropriate orders will be passed.

(DEEPAK GUGLANI) (R.S. NARAYANAN)
 AR-cum-PS COURT MASTER (NSH)
